HEADER: Init +11; Senses Detect chaos, detect evil, detect good, detect law, low-light vision; Perception +14
DEFENSE: AC 22, touch 19, flat-footed 14 (+7 dex, +1 dodge, +3 natural, +1 size)
OFFENSE: Special Attacks Lethe Arrow, Spring Breeze, Zephyr Arrow
At will (DC 14) - Dancing Lights, Daze, Holy Orb, Ghost Sound
1st (DC 15) - Color Spray, Cure, Light, Mage Armor, Regen, Silent Image
2nd (DC 16) - Blur, Cure II, Heal, Jitterbugs, Light II, Magic Mouth
STATISTICS: Str 8, Dex 24, Con 13, Int 16, Wis 18, Cha 18
Feats Combat Casting, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Light Focus, Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +16, Bluff +14, Escape Artist +16, Fly +22, Knowledge (nature) +14, Perception +14, Sense Motive +15, Stealth +20, Use Magic Device +14
SPECIAL ABILITIES: A seelie gains a +4 luck bonus on all saves against figment-based illusions and compulsion effects.
A seelie remains invisible even when it attacks. This ability is constant, but the seelie can suppress or resume it as a free action.

1/day, a seelie shoots out a blue arrow towards her opponent within 60 ft. The seelie must makes a ranged touch attack (+12), if it hits, the attack deals 8d6 points of wind damage and inflicts Silence status effect for 1d6 rounds (Will save DC 19 to negate). Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 25).

1/day, a seelie surrounds herself in a bluish-yellow breeze within a 30-ft.-radius. Creatures within the area of effect must make a Will save (DC 18) or be inflicted with Sleep status effect for 1d6 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 21).

1/day, a seelie can emit a gust of white wind that heals allies other than itself within 20 feet for an amount equal to the seelie's current hit points in damage. The healing received per creature is capped at 10 per hit die attained for the caster (ex: 7 hit dice would mean a cap of 70 healing for each creature). Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 23).

5/day, a seelie shoots out a green arrow towards her opponent within 60 ft. The seelie must makes a ranged touch attack (+12), if it hits, the attack deals 3d6 points of wind damage and knocks her opponent back 10 ft. (Fortitude save DC 19 to negate). Blue mages may learn this ability as a 2nd level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 19).

rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
